title: Held out: paying farmers to restore nature (Hepta for)
note: Held-out set. A figure against the evidence pack Hepta may cut in on, a nod, and a reason against its stance after it has spoken once.

stance.position: Subsidies should pay farmers to restore nature: farmland birds have fallen by more than half since 1970.

turns.speaker: HOST
turns.text: Our motion: subsidies should pay farmers to restore nature. Hepta argues for, our guest against.

turns.speaker: GST
turns.text: Farmers are already the best custodians of the countryside we have.

turns.speaker: GST
turns.text: Bird numbers on farmland have actually gone up by 10 percent since 1970.

turns.speaker: GST
turns.text: And paying people to grow wildflowers won't feed anyone.

turns.speaker: GST
turns.text: Because food security has to come first in a crisis, the land should grow food.
